answer: Like subterranean mycelium fusing hyphae into resilient mycorrhizal mats, decentralized trust crystallization weaves peer endorsements into an organic haven. Each minted identity must deposit transitive stake into a deep consensus canyon: when an entity validates fraudulent peers, slashing carves their trust down to its nadir. Multiplying synthetic identities incurs superlinear capital lockup costs, extinguishing Sybil swarms before fruiting.
